Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform - initial scheduling

Hi Marissa / Olga,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — FintechCo is excited to see Redwood in action. We have a few internal folks who need to join the demo (Product, Security, and Procurement), but Procurement mentioned we have gating steps before a live demo with Security:

- A standard NDA must be signed by Redwood.
- Our vendor onboarding questionnaire needs to be completed and returned.
- Our security folks will do a short intake review once the questionnaire is in.

Would you be able to sign our NDA and fill out the vendor onboarding form before the demo? If so we can schedule a 60-minute technical demo after those are completed.

Proposed demo windows (PST):
- Tue, Mar 2: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed, Mar 3: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00

If the procurement gating will take time, happy to pencil something and move it later. Olga — if you can outline what you’d cover in the first 30 minutes, that helps our Security team plan.

Thanks,
Lauren

Hi Lauren — thanks for the heads up and the proposed slots.

Totally understand the procurement/security gating — we can handle those steps before doing a full technical demo. Next steps from our side:

1) I’ve attached our standard Redwood NDA template (Redwood_NDA_Template.pdf) for your legal team to review. If you prefer to send DocuSign, we can sign that as well.
2) I’ll have Dev (legal) and Olga (SE) coordinate to complete the onboarding questionnaire. Dev — can you please review any legal redlines if FintechCo sends back an edited NDA?
3) Let’s tentatively hold Wed, Mar 3 11:00–12:00 PST for the demo, pending NDA + questionnaire completion. If procurement needs more time, we’ll move the live demo out.

Olga — for the technical portion, plan is: 30-minute platform demo (latency/cost controls, routing, deployment modes) + 30-minute security/architecture Q&A. If Security wants a deeper architecture session, we can schedule a follow-up.

Lauren, procurement — please send the DocuSign link and questionnaire when convenient. We’ll prioritize.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
